summary: MCP server 10: deferred server-side debug commands
author: pm
body:
Deferred by the user (d-028): `kill_player`, `set_status`, `set_god`, the bot flag (need new server debug messages, possibly a protocol_version bump), plus `inject_message` and `set_time_of_day`. Not to be started until the user decides.

**Done when:** the user has decided; if included, planned and filed as its own sub-tasks.

Source: plan `.claude/design/plans/client-agent-mcp.md` (HH-0033, reviewed 2026-11-24); decisions d-027, d-028.
